result.audit_criteria: WebTrust Principles and Criteria for Certification Authorities – SSL Baseline with Network Security – Version 2.4.1

disclosed_matters.summary: Missing 'id-pkix-ocsp-nocheck' extension in a delegated OCSP signing certificate, identified July 14, 2020, representing non-compliance with CA/B Forum Baseline Requirements section 4.9.9.(2); root cause was misconfigured certificate replaced same day with compliant version and processes updated to include SME review.

Two SSL/TLS end-entity certificates had validity period one second greater than 397 days, non-compliant with CA/B Forum B.R. section 6.3.2; identified September 2, 2020, one certificate revoked immediately and second revoked by September 4, 2020; root cause was misinterpretation of RFC5280 inclusive definition and system configuration was updated to enforce maximum 397-day validity.

Two subordinate CAs issued from DST Root CA X3 were missing EKU extensions required by CA/B Forum B.R. section 7.1.2.2g; identified October 6, 2020, revoked same day with approval from ISRG and re-issued October 7, 2020 with correct EKU extensions; root cause was incomplete certificate profile update and incorrect certificate classification.

Forty OV TLS/SSL end-entity certificates contained invalid values for 'stateOrProvinceName', non-compliant with CA/B Forum B.R. section 7.1.6.4; identified June 28, 2021, root cause was logic condition incorrectly handled in production code; all affected certificates were revoked by June 30, 2021 and emergency code fix deployed June 29, 2021.
